items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Were you thinking about it? Starting writing?

I wasn't thinking about it. I didn't know I could write, but because Bob had introduced me to these great writers, I knew what a great writer was. He told me a great song is succinct, it's original, yeah, and he's a great -- he was a great songwriter. "Would I Love You?" Yeah. "No More" with Tudy Camaradi.
Were you working in Las Vegas in those years, also?
